$XREFPROP=$XID={79C09825-BBBE-4609-9C0C-35B2F07B6C26}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={79C09825-BBBE-4609-9C0C-35B2F07B6C26}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

When the seawater cooling system is configured with a main circulation pump, a low supply alarm function shall be provided. The alarm signal shall be capable of being displayed on the bridge or at the main control station so that operators can promptly start the standby pump or change over to the standby pump.

$XREFPROP=$XID={1C696A38-C9A6-4073-BED4-54289EE49A62}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={1C696A38-C9A6-4073-BED4-54289EE49A62}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The seawater cooling system shall be provided with at least two cooling water pumps, one of which shall be a standby pump. The capacity of the standby pump shall not be less than the capacity of the main pump, and at least one pump shall be driven by an independent drive unit.

$XREFPROP=$XID={908670B8-338A-49A9-BEAA-61B767B801AB}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={908670B8-338A-49A9-BEAA-61B767B801AB}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements
The seals, bearings, and motor of the cooling water pump shall be arranged so that they can be directly removed and installed without first moving unrelated piping or other equipment.

$XREFPROP=$XID={FB92AC5A-9A49-4BB8-8328-DA9D24F4CA54}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={FB92AC5A-9A49-4BB8-8328-DA9D24F4CA54}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The maintenance space for the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor shall meet the manufacturer's specified maintenance operation requirements, ensuring that maintenance can be performed without removing unrelated piping.

$XREFPROP=$XID={C70D167E-3C1B-41BF-9425-F0CC76E5BFBD}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={C70D167E-3C1B-41BF-9425-F0CC76E5BFBD}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 79°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 77-85°C.

$XREFPROP=$XID={B69F51AB-D2D2-42E2-87C4-924242575377}$XID;$NAM=Stereotypes$NAM;$TYP=element property$TYP;$VIS=Public$VIS;$PAR=0$PAR;$DES=@STEREO;Name=requirement;FQName=SysML1.4::requirement;@ENDSTEREO;$DES;$CLT={B69F51AB-D2D2-42E2-87C4-924242575377}$CLT;$SUP=<none>$SUP;$ENDXREF;
01_Requirements

The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter.
